name: CKAD Practice Exam — Core
objective: CKAD across all four domains — Application Design & Build (20%), Deployment (20%), Observability & Maintenance (15%), Environment/Config/Security (25%), Services & Networking (20%). Goal: under exam conditions build and operate workloads end to end — Deployments and rollouts, multi-container and init patterns, ConfigMaps/Secrets, probes and resources, Services (ClusterIP/NodePort), Ingress, NetworkPolicy, Jobs/CronJobs, ServiceAccounts, and pod securityContext.
description: A timed-style, no-hints practice exam covering the core CKAD skills. Work in the namespace stated by each task. Everything is object-level — plain kubectl against the cluster, no node access. Weightages sum to 100.

questions.title: Deployment with replicas and scaling
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create a Deployment named `web` using image `nginx:1.25` with **4** replicas. The pod template must carry the label `app=web`. After it is up, scale the Deployment to **6** replicas and ensure all 6 are available.

verification.description: Deployment web exists with image nginx:1.25 and pod label app=web
Deployment web scaled to 6 available replicas

questions.title: Rolling update to a new image
questions.prompt: A Deployment named `roller` (image `nginx:1.24`) already runs in namespace `exam`. Update its container image to `nginx:1.25` and roll it out so the new image is fully live (all replicas updated and available).

verification.description: roller is running nginx:1.25 on all available replicas after rollout

questions.title: Multi-container pod sharing an emptyDir
questions.prompt:
In namespace `exam`, create a pod named `sidecar` with **two** containers sharing one `emptyDir` volume mounted at `/data` in both:

- container `writer` (image `busybox:1.36`) running: `sh -c 'while true; do date >> /data/out.txt; sleep 5; done'`
- container `reader` (image `busybox:1.36`) running: `sh -c 'tail -f /data/out.txt'`

Both containers must mount the same volume at `/data`. The pod must be Running.

verification.description: Pod sidecar has 2 containers both mounting a shared emptyDir at /data and is Running

questions.title: Init container pattern
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create a pod named `initdemo`. It must have an **init container** named `setup` (image `busybox:1.36`) that runs `sh -c 'echo ready > /work/status'` and a main container named `app` (image `busybox:1.36`) that runs `sh -c 'cat /work/status && sleep 3600'`. A single `emptyDir` named `work` must be mounted at `/work` in both. The pod must reach Running with the init container Completed.

verification.description: Pod initdemo has init container 'setup', shared /work volume, and is Running

questions.title: ConfigMap and Secret wired into a pod
questions.prompt:
In namespace `exam`:

1. Create a ConfigMap named `app-cfg` with key `APP_MODE=production`.
2. Create a Secret (Opaque) named `app-sec` with key `API_KEY=s3cr3t`.
3. Create a pod named `consumer` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`) that:
   - sets env var `APP_MODE` from the ConfigMap key `APP_MODE`
   - mounts the Secret `app-sec` as a volume at `/etc/secret` (read path, e.g. file `/etc/secret/API_KEY`).

The pod must be Running.

verification.description: ConfigMap app-cfg and Secret app-sec exist with the right keys/values
Pod consumer has APP_MODE env from configmap and secret mounted at /etc/secret

questions.title: Resource requests and limits
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create a pod named `limited` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`) whose container sets resource **requests** `cpu=100m, memory=64Mi` and **limits** `cpu=250m, memory=128Mi`. The pod must be Running.

verification.description: Pod limited has the exact requests and limits and is Running

questions.title: Liveness and readiness probes
questions.prompt:
In namespace `exam`, create a pod named `probed` using image `nginx:1.25` (container port 80) with both:

- a **liveness** probe: HTTP GET `/` on port `80`, `initialDelaySeconds: 5`, `periodSeconds: 10`
- a **readiness** probe: HTTP GET `/` on port `80`, `initialDelaySeconds: 5`, `periodSeconds: 10`

The pod must become Ready.

verification.description: Pod probed has HTTP liveness + readiness probes on port 80 and is Ready

questions.title: ClusterIP Service for a deployment
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, a Deployment named `clip` (image `nginx:1.25`, label `app=clip`, container port 80) already runs. Create a **ClusterIP** Service named `clip-svc` that selects `app=clip`, exposing port `80` → targetPort `80`. The Service must have at least one ready endpoint.

verification.description: Service clip-svc is ClusterIP selecting app=clip with ready endpoints

questions.title: NodePort Service on a specific port
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, a Deployment named `np` (image `nginx:1.25`, label `app=np`, container port 80) already runs. Create a **NodePort** Service named `np-svc` selecting `app=np`, port `80` → targetPort `80`, with nodePort fixed to **30080**. The Service must have at least one ready endpoint.

verification.description: Service np-svc is NodePort on 30080 selecting app=np with endpoints

questions.title: Ingress host/path rule
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create an Ingress named `shop-ing` that routes host `shop.example.com`, path `/` (pathType `Prefix`) to Service `clip-svc` on port `80`. (The Service exists from task 8.)

verification.description: Ingress shop-ing routes shop.example.com/ to clip-svc:80

questions.title: NetworkPolicy: default-deny + allow-from-label
questions.prompt:
In namespace `exam` create two NetworkPolicies:

1. `default-deny` — selects **all** pods (empty podSelector) and denies all **ingress** (policyTypes: Ingress, no ingress rules).
2. `allow-web` — selects pods with label `app=clip` and allows ingress **only** from pods carrying label `role=frontend`.

Both must exist in namespace `exam`.

verification.description: default-deny selects all pods and denies all ingress
allow-web permits ingress to app=clip only from role=frontend

questions.title: Job with completions and parallelism
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create a Job named `pi-job` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'echo done'`) with `completions: 4` and `parallelism: 2`. Let it finish; it must reach 4 successful completions.

verification.description: Job pi-job has completions=4, parallelism=2 and succeeded 4 times

questions.title: CronJob with a schedule
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create a CronJob named `beat` with schedule `*/5 * * * *` whose job template runs a single container (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'date'`). The CronJob must exist with exactly that schedule.

verification.description: CronJob beat exists with schedule */5 * * * * and the right image

questions.title: ServiceAccount used by a pod
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create a ServiceAccount named `app-sa`. Then create a pod named `sa-pod` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`) that runs under ServiceAccount `app-sa`. The pod must be Running.

verification.description: ServiceAccount app-sa exists and pod sa-pod runs under it

questions.title: Pod securityContext: runAsNonRoot + drop caps
questions.prompt: In namespace `exam`, create a pod named `hardened` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`) whose container securityContext sets `runAsNonRoot: true`, `runAsUser: 1000`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, and `capabilities.drop: ["ALL"]`. The pod must be Running.

verification.description: Pod hardened runs non-root (uid 1000), no priv-esc, drops ALL caps, is Running
